name: command-dialog
title: Command dialog
description: A command palette in a dialog, opened with Ctrl+K or Cmd+K.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandGroupHeading, CommandInput, CommandInputWrapper, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandShortcut, } from '@/ui/command/command'; import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogPortal, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, } from '@/ui/dialog/dialog'; /** * A command palette in a dialog, opened with its button or with Ctrl+K * (⌘K on a Mac). Running a command closes it. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-command-dialog', imports: [ Button, Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandGroupHeading, CommandInput, CommandInputWrapper, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandShortcut, Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogPortal, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, NdIcon, ], host: { '(document:keydown)': 'shortcut($event)' }, template: `

Command palette

Search for a command to run.

No results found.
Suggestions
Calendar
Search emoji
Settings
Profile ⌘P
Settings ⌘S

{{ ran() }}

`, }) export class CommandDialogExample { protected readonly open = signal(false); protected readonly ran = signal(''); /** * Opens or closes the palette for Ctrl+K or ⌘K. * * @param event - A keydown anywhere in the document. */ protected shortcut(event: KeyboardEvent): void { if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'k' && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) { event.preventDefault(); this.open.update((open) => !open); } } /** * Runs a command and closes the palette. * * @param name - The command's name. */ protected run(name: string): void { this.ran.set(`Ran ${name}.`); this.open.set(false); } }
